Source Marquiste Additions

Requirements A ginger chew is in your mouth: its effect is on you

You bite down on the ginger chew. Reduce your sickened value by 1, if any. The chew becomes inert, and its effect ends.

Module Using this action reduces your sickened value by 1 and removes the effect that gave you this action. It can be switched off in the module settings under Wandering Chef.
